_comment: Regression baseline for the shared-memory transport gate, for the 64-byte, concurrency-1 cells. Recaptured after the uds transport's per-receive SO_RCVTIMEO hoist (internal/transport/uds.go): the receive timeout is now cached and reprogrammed only when it changes, which sped up the production-uds reference cell and, by design of the ratio gate, shifted the shm-vs-uds ratio below the prior baseline's tolerance. The shm-vs-grpc ratio had separately drifted below tolerance from movement in the untouched grpc-uds reference cell, observed in captures both before and after the hoist. All four cells below come from one captured run (median of 10 reps per cell); latency medians and allocs copied together per this file's own refresh policy, none hand-edited. allocs_per_op is unchanged from the prior baseline for every cell. To refresh, recapture a bench run: copy the latency medians and take the allocs from the current run; do not hand-edit measured values.
